trip.title: Japan 2027
trip.note: Six PTO days, exactly at cap. Fares tracked on the Flights tab; nothing on this page is booked until it says so.

milestones.name: Repo in service
milestones.note: Tracker live, polling every other day, history accumulating.

milestones.name: PTO committed
milestones.note: Six weekdays requested and approved. Asked for in autumn it is uncontroversial; asked for in March it competes with everyone.

milestones.name: Flights locked
milestones.note: Tickets bought. Ends the buy window that opens around Travel Tuesday, 1 Dec 2026.

milestones.name: Final itinerary
milestones.note: Hotels booked, days fixed. Everything downstream -- sumo, rail, eSIMs -- gets cheaper or easier once this is settled.

milestones.name: SFO synchronization
milestones.note: Four people, one departure. Wheels up.

days.title: SFO → HND
days.note: Leaves Friday, lands Saturday -- the date line eats a day. Bags checked through; Yamato-forward the big ones from the airport so the first evening isn't spent hauling them.

days.title: Land Haneda, settle in
days.note: Arrival afternoon. Nothing scheduled -- Suica/Welcome Suica on the phone, eat close to the hotel, sleep early to break the jet lag.

days.title: Central Tokyo on foot
days.note: First full day. Keep it walkable and low-commitment while everyone is still on the wrong clock.

days.title: Sumo — Natsu basho, Ryōgoku
days.note: The one fixed-cost ticket. Natsu basho runs mid-May at the Kokugikan; a weekday masu-seki box seats exactly four. Confirm the 2027 dates when the schedule publishes and move this day to match.

days.title: Open
days.note: Day trip if the group wants one -- Nikkō, Kamakura, Hakone all work as a single out-and-back from Tokyo.

days.title: Open — last Tokyo day
days.note: The spare eighth night lives here. Pack for the Shinkansen; Yamato the big bags ahead to the Kyoto hotel rather than carrying them.

days.title: Shinkansen to Kyoto
days.note: Morning train, ~2h20m on the Nozomi. Reserve point-to-point on Smart EX -- this routing never earns a JR Pass back.

days.title: Kyoto, full day
days.note: The one day with no travel attached. Early start beats the coach tours to anything well known.

days.title: Kyoto → Osaka
days.note: Short hop, under an hour. Last night of the trip, and the one that has to be near enough to KIX for a morning flight.

days.title: KIX → SFO
days.note: Morning departure out of Kansai, home the same calendar day. Allow for the airport being an hour out from central Osaka.

bookings.note: Tracked on the Flights tab. Rule set in advance: at or below the recalibrated floor on the target pairing, book same day without consulting the group chat.
Free-cancellation rate, booked early, re-checked in April.
Free-cancellation rate. Kyoto sells out earlier than Tokyo.
Near enough to a KIX train for a morning departure.

bookings.what: Sumo — masu-seki box for four, Ryōgoku
bookings.note: On sale roughly a month ahead; the good boxes move fast. A weekday box seats exactly four.
Point-to-point on Smart EX. Skip the JR Pass -- this routing doesn't earn it back.
Four individual eSIMs, not one shared pocket wifi -- the group splits up during the day.
Arranged on the day, hotel to hotel. Turns both train legs into hand-luggage-only.
